record: Sealed 6v6 results package for the ICRA Results section
status: PARTIAL -- crossover eval in flight; robustness block reserved and unspent
discipline: Every value below is copied from a sealed artifact. The one PENDING field is marked as such and must not be filled by estimate.
why_6v6_differs_structurally_from_2v2: 2v2 localizes WHERE progressive sharing breaks specialization (Share-0/Encoder/Backbone/Macro). 6v6 rebuilds ONLY the rung that survived that localization (shared perception encoder, private strategy capacity) and asks whether it survives scale. Expert crossover re-certification and the full ladder are deliberately not rebuilt at 6v6 -- a scope decision, not a missing measurement.

compression_invariance.claim: The deployed actor parameter count is IDENTICAL at 2v2 and 6v6 because the actor is per-agent weight-shared: team size changes the observation batch dimension, not any parameter shape.

size_normalization.note: guard response distributes ceil(N/2) defenders rather than stacking them on one intruder

strategic_demand.cross_scale_reading: Demand does not weaken with team size. The Regime-B contrast is substantially LARGER at 6v6 (+0.625) than at 2v2 (+0.453), driven by guard-style play collapsing against the breach regime (0.078) while breach-style play holds (0.703).

specialist_teachers.checkpoint_rule: Only the terminal-budget checkpoint is scored; periodic checkpoints are diagnostics and may not be cherry-picked.
specialist_teachers.role_in_paper: distillation teachers only -- expert crossover is NOT re-certified at 6v6

distillation_rung1.architecture: shared ['actor_cnn']; everything else private per z
distillation_rung1.cross_scale_reading: Both scales retain ~99% of the teachers' branch divergence (2v2: 0.178 of 0.179; 6v6: 0.478 of 0.484). Note the 6v6 teachers are far more behaviorally distinct in absolute terms. Fidelity is a precondition for asking the payoff question, not an answer to it -- 2v2 Share-Macro held 0.936/0.969 agreement and still FAILED the criterion.

crossover_eval.status: PENDING -- IN FLIGHT, DO NOT ESTIMATE
crossover_eval.gate: PASS iff delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0

pre_committed_interpretation.if_pass: the shared-perception compression that preserved complementary specialization at 2v2 also preserves it at 6v6; the 48% deployment saving transfers to a materially harder coordination problem
pre_committed_interpretation.if_fail: the compression result is scale-bounded; the sharing boundary located at 2v2 does not by itself license deployment at larger team sizes and must be re-established per scale
pre_committed_interpretation.note: Interpretation was fixed before the result existed. Per the standing no-second-attempt discipline, a FAIL does not authorize retraining, reselecting architecture, or tuning the distillation schedule.

robustness.planned_cells: 4 cells (poleA/poleB x z0/z1) x families x severities
robustness.gating_rule: Runs only after the crossover eval seals PASS. Running robustness on an unconfirmed crossover would characterize the degradation of a property not yet shown to exist.
robustness.estimated_runtime: 2048 episodes; the longest stage in the 6v6 pipeline

not_in_this_package.4v4: excluded from the Results section by PI direction 2026-09-11; its sealed records remain on disk and are unaffected
